title: Open icon.svg, open a scene, select a node, ERROR: Attempt to disconnect a nonexistent connection
body:
### Tested versions

### Reproducible in:
v4.8.dev6.official [8898c2b3d]

### Not reproducible in:
v4.7.2.stable.official [ed1daf0bf]

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev6 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors (853x683 @ 60.02 Hz, 1920x1080 @ 60.00 Hz) - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - GeForce GTX 550 Ti - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-2100 CPU @ 3.10GHz (4 threads) - 11.95 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Open icon.svg, open a scene, and selecting a scene node:
>  ERROR: Attempt to disconnect a nonexistent connection from '():<ViewportTexture#-9223367708769180455>'. Signal: 'property_list_changed', callable: 'ConnectionsDock::_changed_callback'.


### Steps to reproduce

- open the project: [error_open_icon_open_scene.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32432031/error_open_icon_open_scene.zip)
- open the output panel
- in filesystem panel, double-click: icon.svg
- in filesystem panel, double-click: node_2d.tscn
- in the scene panel, click: Node2D


### Issue
>  ERROR: Attempt to disconnect a nonexistent connection from '():<ViewportTexture#-9223367708769180455>'. Signal: 'property_list_changed', callable: 'ConnectionsDock::_changed_callback'.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/02fc804b-bcf5-4e38-a388-ad4f52570797


### Notes
Closing a scene remembers if a node was selected or not.

When node_2d.tscn opens:
- Error, if Node2D was selected before node_2d.tscn was closed.
- No error, if Node2D wasn't selected before node_2d.tscn was closed.
But as soon as Node2D is selected, then the error appears.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8c15be59-9a86-4232-adf4-f28ac0a94652

#### Same error without a saved scene
Without any open scenes:
- in filesystem panel, double-click: icon.svg
- on the scenes' tab bar, click the new scene button
- note: nothing changes visually
- in the scene panel click: 2D Scene

>  ERROR: Attempt to disconnect a nonexistent connection from '():<ViewportTexture#-9223365198830558921>'. Signal: 'property_list_changed', callable: 'ConnectionsDock::_changed_callback'.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f1b4967f-d6c9-477d-9fe9-75218d2c5d2b

Sometimes the error doesn't occur, after closing the modified unsaved scene, and repeating the steps. But repeating the steps again causes the error.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[error_open_icon_open_scene.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32432031/error_open_icon_open_scene.zip)
